heroPreview.subtitle: Permukaan ini bukan pratinjau dasbor. Ini adalah ekstrak formal tentang bagaimana Afenda mengubah pergerakan operasional menjadi kebenaran bisnis kanonis yang dapat dioperasikan, diatur, dan diaudit.

ledger.title: Buku kontrol dari peristiwa ke catatan
ledger.description: Setiap peristiwa operasional harus melewati pengikatan identitas, evaluasi kebijakan, dan pelampiran bukti sebelum diizinkan menggerakkan status bisnis.

resolved.title: Status operasional terselesaikan
resolved.description: Afenda tidak menambahkan lapisan interpretasi lain. Afenda menyelesaikan status yang dapat dioperasikan, dipertahankan, dan direkonsiliasi oleh bisnis.
resolved.body: Status yang diterima dibatasi tenant, terikat aktor, diuji kebijakan, dan terhubung ke bukti yang diperlukan untuk menjelaskan mengapa status itu ada.

auditPosture.value: Dihasilkan oleh operasi, bukan direkonstruksi kemudian

consequence.label: Konsekuensi bisnis
consequence.title: Tidak ada penyelamatan naratif setelah fakta terjadi.
consequence.body: Sistem memaksa kebenaran diproduksi pada saat operasi berlangsung, sehingga keuangan, audit, manajemen, dan eksekusi bekerja dari catatan terselesaikan yang sama.

system.title: Afenda is not a feature surface. It is the canonical layer beneath operational judgment.
system.description: The product exists to prevent the familiar enterprise failure: useful activity spread across tools, but no single accountable record strong enough for decision, audit, and control.

recordDiscipline.label: Record discipline
recordDiscipline.title: Every operational event resolves into a governed source of truth.
recordDiscipline.body: Afenda treats documents, entities, actions, approvals, and state transitions as durable business facts, not as disconnected interface activity.

evidenceBinding.label: Evidence binding
evidenceBinding.title: The system keeps proof close to the decision it supports.
evidenceBinding.body: A decision without lineage is only a claim. Afenda binds actor, time, tenant, source, reason, and resulting state into a traceable operating layer.

resolutionControl.label: Resolution control
resolutionControl.title: Conflicting activity is resolved by policy, not by memory.
resolutionControl.body: When systems disagree, the operating model needs precedence, auditability, and controlled mutation. Afenda is built around that discipline.

topology.title: Satu alur dari sinyal mentah ke catatan yang dapat dipertahankan.
topology.description: Afenda tidak menyebar kebenaran di banyak alat. Masukan dinormalisasi, dievaluasi di inti resolusi, dan dikeluarkan sebagai status kanonik dengan visibilitas audit.
topology.thesis: Jika organisasi tidak dapat menggambar garis ini dalam satu diagram, ia tidak memiliki satu kebenaran operasional—hanya interpretasi yang diperselisihkan.

identity.title: Sinyal identitas
identity.body: Aktor, penyewa, dan konteks kepemilikan sebagai fakta tingkat pertama.

skills.title: Graf kemampuan
skills.body: Keterampilan, kemahiran, dan struktur tenaga kerja sebagai atribut yang diatur.

activity.title: Telemetri eksekusi
activity.body: Peristiwa alur kerja, dokumen, dan HRIS dengan sumber dan stempel waktu.

knowledge.title: Objek pengetahuan
knowledge.body: Artefak dan catatan pembelajaran terikat pada cakupan dan kebijakan.

identityBinding.title: Pengikatan identitas
identityBinding.body: Setiap transisi terikat pada aktor dan penyewa sebelum kebijakan dijalankan.

policyResolution.title: Resolusi kebijakan
policyResolution.body: Otoritas, presedensi, dan aturan menentukan status yang boleh berubah.

evidenceCommit.title: Komit bukti
evidenceCommit.body: Bukti dilampirkan saat catatan ditulis—bukan dibuat ulang kemudian.

audit.label: Jejak audit
audit.value: Jalur terlacak dari sinyal ke status yang diterima.

consequence.label: Konsekuensi desain
consequence.title: Tanpa otoritas paralel.
consequence.body: Jika saluran dapat mengubah kebenaran bisnis tanpa melalui tulang punggung ini, Afenda sengaja tidak menganggapnya teratur.

surface.title: The interface is reduced to what the organization must know, prove, and control.
surface.description: No decorative dashboards. No synthetic theatre. The operational surface exists to expose canonical records, policy decisions, evidence links, and state movement.

integrationReality.title: Sistem eksternal menyumbang sinyal. Afenda mempertahankan otoritas.
integrationReality.description: ERP, HRIS, identitas, dan kolaborasi tetap sebagai sumber—bukan buku besar kebenaran yang bersaing. Setiap jalur masuk melewati cakupan identitas, normalisasi, tata kelola, dan disiplin komit.
integrationReality.quote: Integrasi membuktikan apa yang melewati batas—bukan apa yang boleh dipercaya bisnis.

systems.body: Workday, SAP, BambooHR, ATS, LMS, tiket—dimasukkan sebagai sumber teratur berstempel waktu.

knowledge.body: Objek Confluence, Notion, Drive terdaftar dengan kepemilikan, sensitivitas, dan tag kebijakan.

governance.body: Paket aturan, rantai persetujuan, break-glass, dan deteksi drift sebelum status maju.

boundary.title: Urutan tanpa jalan pintas
boundary.description: Setiap tahap wajib. Melewatkan tahap bukan opsi konfigurasi—itu kontrak integrasi yang gagal.

govern.label: Tata kelola
govern.value: Kebijakan, persetujuan, dan pengecualian dievaluasi dengan persyaratan bukti.

consequence.label: Aturan operasi
consequence.title: Integrasi tidak mendapat pintu samping ke kebenaran.
consequence.body: Jika vendor atau alur bayangan tidak dapat menunjukkan bukti yang sama, itu bukan bagian model operasi teratur—terlepas dari kenyamanan UI.

input.title: Peristiwa masuk sebagai fakta yang membawa bukti.
input.description: Dokumen, tindakan, integrasi, identitas, dan perubahan status ditangkap dengan konteks cukup untuk dinilai nanti.

control.title: Kebijakan menentukan otoritas dan presedensi.
control.description: Sistem mengevaluasi cakupan penyewa, otoritas peran, keandalan sumber, dan ikatan aturan sebelum status boleh bergerak.

truth.title: Catatan kanonik diselesaikan dan disimpan.
truth.description: Status yang dihasilkan dapat diperiksa, diaudit, dan digunakan di seluruh organisasi tanpa mengandalkan penjelasan manual.

domains.title: Capabilities are expressed as enterprise controls, not feature cards.
domains.description: Each domain answers one question: what can the organization rely on when operational pressure, system disagreement, and audit scrutiny arrive together?

canonicalRecords.title: Canonical records
canonicalRecords.body: Operational entities, documents, events, and transitions are normalized into accountable records with stable ownership, scope, and identity.
canonicalRecords.proof: Reduces duplicate truth surfaces and prevents record drift across teams, tools, and tenants.

evidenceBinding.title: Evidence binding
evidenceBinding.body: Every material state carries the proof required to defend it: source, actor, timestamp, reason, tenant boundary, and decision path.
evidenceBinding.proof: Turns operational claims into inspectable facts before audit pressure arrives.

governanceControls.title: Governance controls
governanceControls.body: Policy, role, approval, precedence, and exception handling are treated as first-class controls rather than implementation comments.
governanceControls.proof: Keeps operational change inside a controlled spine instead of relying on informal process memory.

auditContinuity.title: Audit continuity
auditContinuity.body: The system preserves the path from original event to current state, including reversals, overrides, and resolution authority.
auditContinuity.proof: Supports executive review, regulatory inspection, and internal accountability without narrative reconstruction.

operationalResolution.title: Operational resolution
operationalResolution.body: When incoming facts conflict, Afenda resolves them through declared precedence, tenant scope, and evidence quality.
operationalResolution.proof: Prevents the business from manually negotiating which system should be believed.

enterpriseIntegration.title: Enterprise integration
enterpriseIntegration.body: External systems connect as sources and consumers of truth, not as uncontrolled parallel ledgers.
enterpriseIntegration.proof: Allows ERP, identity, document, and workflow systems to participate without fragmenting authority.

commercial.title: Siap pengadaan tanpa teater pengadaan.
commercial.description: Afenda menyelaraskan hukum, keamanan, dan implementasi pada fakta arsitektur yang sama: otoritas terbatas, bukti dipertahankan, dan satu postur catatan kanonik.

governance.body: Matriks kontrol, kerangka DPIA, model segregasi, peta retensi—diekspor dari konfigurasi aktif.

implementation.body: Onboarding bertahap dengan rollback eksplisit, gerbang validasi, dan kriteria sukses terikat catatan kanonik.

security.title: Bukti keamanan
security.body: Rotasi rahasia, ikatan SSO, silsilah audit tak terubah, routing anomali terdokumentasi—bukan hanya klaim.

commercial.title: Struktur komersial
commercial.body: Kapasitas, tingkat dukungan, dan batas tanggung jawab terhadap kontrol fitur nyata—tanpa SKU rak.

process.title: Dari percakapan pertama ke produksi teratur
process.description: Setiap langkah menghasilkan artefak bertanda tangan. Tidak ada yang mengandalkan narasi kosong.

align.label: Selaraskan

consequence.label: Konsekuensi komersial
consequence.title: Kontrak mengutip arsitektur—bukan slide.
consequence.body: Saat sengketa atau audit, kedua pihak menelusuri kewajiban ke kontrol terdaftar dan catatan tak terubah—bukan klaim pemasaran yang ditafsir ulang.

guarantees.title: Credibility comes from what the system can prove under pressure.
guarantees.description: The guarantee is not speed, dashboards, or generic automation. The guarantee is that the organization can inspect how an operational state became true.

canonicalState.title: One canonical state
canonicalState.body: The business does not need three reports and a meeting to decide which record is true.

decisionPath.title: Traceable decision path
decisionPath.body: Every material decision can be followed through actor, source, policy, reason, and resulting state.

tenantBounded.title: Tenant-bounded records
tenantBounded.body: Records remain scoped to the correct tenant, legal entity, operating boundary, and authority model.

auditReady.title: Audit-ready evidence
auditReady.body: Evidence is retained as part of the operational record, not collected later as a separate rescue exercise.

controlledChange.title: Controlled change
controlledChange.body: Overrides, exceptions, and reversals move through visible governance rather than hidden operational shortcuts.

integrationDiscipline.title: Integration discipline
integrationDiscipline.body: Connected systems exchange truth through controlled boundaries instead of becoming competing authorities.

evidence.title: Kepercayaan adalah properti catatan—bukan dek presentasi.
evidence.description: Afenda menjadikan bukti struktural: pengikatan identitas, evaluasi kebijakan, komit kanonik, dan visibilitas audit adalah tahap yang terlihat, bukan catatan tambahan.
evidence.quote: Jika tidak dapat dilacak, itu bukan bukti—itu opini.

consequence.label: Postur audit
consequence.title: Utang bukti bermajemuk—Afenda amortisasi saat menulis.
consequence.body: Organisasi yang menunda pengambilan bukti membayar bunga majemuk pada setiap audit, sengketa, atau transisi kepemimpinan berikutnya. Bukti struktural menghindari trajektori itu.

closing.title: The system either knows the truth, or the business negotiates it manually.
closing.description: Afenda is designed for the former: a governed truth layer where operational records survive growth, integration pressure, tenant complexity, and executive review without requiring narrative rescue.

readiness.title: Enterprise adoption begins with evidence, scope, and operating discipline.
readiness.description: These are the questions the product is built to answer before procurement, rollout, or executive sponsorship creates pressure.

replacement.question: What does Afenda replace?
replacement.answer: Afenda does not begin as a replacement for ERP, document storage, or workflow tools. It establishes the truth layer that governs how operational facts become reliable records across those systems.

start.question: Where does implementation start?
start.answer: Implementation starts with the highest-risk truth surface: records where conflicting sources, manual reconciliation, approval ambiguity, or audit exposure already create operational cost.

integrations.question: How does Afenda handle integrations?
integrations.answer: Integrations are treated as governed sources and consumers. They are not allowed to silently create a second authority without identity, scope, precedence, and evidence rules.

enterpriseGrade.question: What makes this enterprise-grade?
enterpriseGrade.answer: The enterprise posture comes from tenant boundaries, evidence retention, audit continuity, policy-driven state transitions, and a product model that treats control as architecture rather than an afterthought.

executiveReview.question: How should executives evaluate the product?
executiveReview.answer: Evaluate whether Afenda can explain who changed what, why it changed, which source was trusted, whose authority applied, when the state became true, and how the evidence survives review.

executiveClose.title: Langkah berikutnya adalah tinjauan arsitektur—bukan demo lagi.
executiveClose.description: Afenda menerbitkan ontologi yang sama untuk pengadaan, pembangun, auditor, dan operator. Putuskan apakah satu tulang punggung kebenaran struktural lebih baik daripada biaya rekonsiliasi yang meningkat.

governance.title: Dossier tata kelola
governance.body: Paket kebijakan, overlay RACI, diagram segregasi, kerangka DPIA—diekspor sebagai bundel berversi.

review.title: Memo tinjauan red-team
review.body: Delta pentest pihak ketiga, kontrol kriptografis, hasil drill rantai anomaly.

close.label: Pos pemeriksaan keputusan
close.title: Tidak ada ketidaktahuan arsitektur tersisa?
close.body: Jika ada item masih “akan ditentukan saat implementasi,” tinjauan belum selesai—skala tidak memperbaiki kontrol ambigu.
